''See also: [[Blood Sage Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Blood [[Sage]] is a powerful figure and the founder of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] cult. He possesses a skeletal, emaciated appearance characterized by extremely pale skin and long white hair that reaches his feet. A distinctive feature of his visage is the red markings trailing from his eyes, giving him the appearance of weeping [[blood]]. He often maintains a hunched or crouched posture. As a [[Sage]], he possesses immense power and has demonstrated the ability to transport groups of Overlords across vast distances using spatial anchors. He is a skilled instructor, having developed unique techniques for the cultivation of [[Blood Shadows]] and claiming Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius as his [[disciple]]. His expertise extends to the integration of powerful [[blood]] essences and [[madra]] into spiritual [[constructs]], such as helping a student integrate ancient creature samples into their [[Shadow]]. He is also associated with the Heart's Gem, a supreme natural treasure composed of Blood aura{{!}}blood aura derived from the [[Redmoon Herald]], who formerly served as his [[Blood Shadow]]. In combat and research, the Blood [[Sage]] is described as predictable but formidable, capable of utilizing various [[blood]]-based techniques and [[elixirs]]. Even after death, his influence persists through his [[Remnant]], which manifests as a crimson [[skeleton]] with floating eyes.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Blood [[Sage]] is a tall, skeletal man with white hair that reaches down to his knees. His face has a skeletal appearance and features scarlet lines running from his eyes that resemble bloody tears.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A researcher who was once called a mad tool of a [[Dreadgod]], he claims to be part of a revolution in the [[sacred arts]] intended to surpass Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss. He expresses interest in examining [[Yerin]] and observing her combination with [[Ruby]] at [[Archlord]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He utilizes [[blood]] techniques and a [[Forged claw]] to slash through [[Hollow Armor]]. Additionally, he possesses a [[void space]], can transmit his voice through [[aura]], and uses a syringe filled with a shining violet elixirs{{!}}elixir.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Blood [[Sage]] was brought forth by [[Seishen Daji]] through the use of a [[spatial anchor]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c3">''Bloodline'', chapter 3</ref> Known as the [[Sage of Red Faith]], this entity manifests as a tall, skeletal man featuring knee-length white hair and red lines trailing from his eyes like bloody tears.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14">''Bloodline'', chapter 14</ref> He asserts that he belongs to a revolution within the [[sacred arts]] intended to surpass Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14" /> While [[Eithan]] had encountered the Blood [[Sage]] in combat previously, the entity later utilized a teleportation anchor to move Overlords.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Researcher of the Red Faith}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Once referred to as the ghost child and the mad tool of a [[Dreadgod]], the Blood [[Sage]] is now a researcher.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref> He maintains that [[Redmoon]]'s organization is considered a cult only because of its leader, asserting that he would run it as a research society instead.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" /> This individual, who possesses a [[void space]] and utilizes a syringe containing a shining violet elixirs{{!}}elixir, has a skeletal face.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14">''Dreadgod'', chapter 14</ref> Despite having a twin, the white-haired Blood [[Sage]] slunk past [[Yerin]] and [[Little Blue]] while believed to be mortally injured.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> He also employs [[blood]] techniques.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref>}}
